notes: Cheque-management grants of a group (BANK_PASSWORD banks, CHECK_TRNS_PASSWORD transaction types); duplicate-bank message, all banks / all types / select all / none buttons (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/CHECKPASS.md)

row_rules.BANK_PASSWORD: if inserting then app_rules3_se.dup_row('BANK_PASSWORD', :new.password_number, :new.bank_code); end if;

BANK_PASSWORD.BANK_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, code r from bank order by 1

CHECK_TRNS_PASSWORD.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(desc_e, desc_a) else desc_a end d, trns_type_code r from check_trns_type order by 1

actions.name: ALL_TRNS
actions.confirm_a: سيتم استبدال حركات المجموعة بكل الحركات. هل تريد الاستمرار؟
actions.confirm_e: Replace the group's transaction types by all types?

params.name: FLAG
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'إختيار الكل' a, 'Select all' e, 1 r from dual union all select 'استبعاد الكل', 'Deselect all', 0 from dual) order by r desc
